t: You're looking at the wall on Hanbury Street where a mural called Freedom for Humanity was painted in mid-September 2012. It's gone now. The American artist Mear One, based in Los Angeles, made it. It showed men in business suits playing a Monopoly-like game on the backs of bent-over naked figures, with an Eye of Providence watching over them. Mear One is known for political street art, and this temporary work was one of his best-known pieces.
